name: browser_snapshot
description: Observe current-page elements and panels, including iframes. Use view=tabs only to find or manage pages. Use observed refs unchanged; query browser_read to find a known target. Add image=true only when visual context is needed.

diff.description: Compare with this page's last unscoped snapshot or action feedback; default false. A new document returns a full snapshot.

image.description: Include a full-page WebP image annotated with element refs, proportionally reduced to a maximum edge of 1980 pixels; default false. For unannotated images, timed sequences or saved PNGs, use screen_observe.

page_id.description: Page ID from browser_snapshot(view='tabs'). Default: focused tab, or an available tab.

recent_tasks_limit.description: Number of recent browser and screenshot task summaries, newest first: 0-10; default 0.

ref.description: Element ref from an observation. Scope the element list and optional text to its subtree. Default: whole page. Floating panels and images remain page-wide. Excludes diff=true.

text.description: Include up to 40 lines of page text within the selected scope; default false.

view.description: Default page observes the selected page; tabs lists open pages only, ignoring page-specific options.

name: browser_act
description: Execute consecutive browser or desktop steps in order in one actions batch, with page feedback at the end. Use observed refs; end the batch when later targets need fresh refs. To pause, use actions:[{"do":"wait","secs":5}]; for a page condition use text or gone. While state=running, use op=wait with the same task_id; op=cancel requests cancellation. Inspect page feedback to confirm website outcomes before submitting again.

oneOf.description: Click an element ref, or a point in a returned page or desktop image. Prefer ref when available.

double.description: Double-click instead of a single click; default false.

image_id.description: For coordinates: image_id from browser_snapshot or screen_observe; copy unchanged.

x.description: Horizontal coordinate in returned image pixels, less than image width.

y.description: Vertical coordinate in returned image pixels, less than image height.

oneOf.description: Replace the text of an editable page element.

ref.description: Editable element ref from an observation.

submit.description: Press Enter after filling; default false.

text.description: Replacement text; an empty string clears the element.

oneOf.description: Select one option in a native HTML select element.

ref.description: Native select element ref from an observation.

value.description: Exact option value or label. Value matches take precedence; the match must be unique.

oneOf.description: Set the checked state of a checkable page element.

ref.description: Checkable element ref from an observation.

oneOf.description: Send a key or chord to the selected page, an element ref, or the focused desktop control.

key.description: Browser key or chord, such as "Enter" or "Control+a".

ref.description: Element ref from an observation. When omitted, send keys to the selected page's focused element.

target.description: Input target; default page. desktop uses the focused desktop control and ignores ref.

oneOf.description: Move the pointer over the referenced page element.
Drag between element refs, or between points in one returned image. Page image endpoints must fit in one viewport.

image_id.description: For coordinates: image_id from browser_snapshot or screen_observe; copy unchanged.

ref.description: Source element ref; when set, use to_ref and ignore image coordinates.

to_x.description: Destination horizontal coordinate in the same image pixels.

to_y.description: Destination vertical coordinate in the same image pixels.

x.description: Start horizontal coordinate in returned image pixels.

y.description: Start vertical coordinate in returned image pixels.

oneOf.description: Upload files from the connected Runcove space through a page's file input or file chooser.

paths.description: 1-20 absolute paths to readable regular files in the connected Runcove space, using the same filesystem as bash/read/write.

ref.description: Observed ref of a file input or an element that opens a file chooser.

oneOf.description: Click a page element to start a download, save the file in the Runcove space, and return its file information.

ref.description: Observed ref of the element that starts the download.

timeout_secs.description: Seconds to wait for the download event and, separately, save it: 1-60; default 30.

oneOf.description: Scroll an element into view, scroll to find text, or send vertical wheel input to the selected page.

delta.description: For desktop: wheel steps, -30..30; positive scrolls down.

dy.description: Vertical wheel distance per scroll in CSS pixels: -20000..20000; default 800. Positive values scroll down.

exact.description: For until_text only: require an exact text match; default false.

max.description: For until_text only: maximum number of scrolls, 1-30; default 15.

ref.description: Element ref returned by browser_snapshot, browser_read or browser_act; copy unchanged to scroll it into view. Ignores other scroll options.

target.description: Scroll target; default page. desktop requires image_id, x, y and delta; ignores page scroll options.

until_text.description: Nonempty text to find by scrolling, checking the selected page and its iframes. Uses substring matching unless exact=true.

x.description: For desktop: horizontal coordinate in returned image pixels.

y.description: For desktop: vertical coordinate in returned image pixels.

oneOf.description: Wait for visible text or an element name, including iframes, or pause. Provide one of text, gone or secs. Element interactions already wait for the target to be actionable.

gone.description: Wait until no visible text or accessible element name matches this case-insensitive substring.

secs.description: Fixed delay in seconds, 0-60, independent of page state. Ignores timeout_secs.

text.description: Wait for visible text or an accessible element name to appear. Case-insensitive substring, as in observations.

timeout_secs.description: Page-condition timeout in seconds, 1-60; default 60. Returns as soon as the condition is met.

oneOf.description: Open a URL, go back or forward, or reload the selected page.

mode.description: Navigation mode: open (default), back, forward or reload.

url.description: Required for open: absolute http, https, file, about or data URL. Other modes ignore url. File URLs use the connected space's filesystem.

oneOf.description: Create, close or focus a browser tab. Creating or focusing a tab selects it for subsequent page actions in this batch.

action.description: "new" creates a tab; "close" closes a tab; "focus" brings a tab to the foreground.

page_id.description: For close/focus only: tab ID from browser_snapshot(view='tabs'). Default: the currently selected tab.

url.description: For new only: initial absolute URL using http, https, file, about or data. Default: a blank page. File URLs refer to the connected Runcove space's filesystem.

oneOf.description: Set the policy for JS alert, confirm or prompt dialogs opened by later page steps in this batch. Place this step before the triggering action. Without a policy, dialogs are dismissed and reported. For an already-open native dialog, use a desktop image and desktop actions.

accept.description: true accepts subsequent dialogs; false dismisses them.

text.description: Text supplied when accepting a prompt dialog.

oneOf.description: Enter text into the currently focused control on the Runcove desktop, including native dialogs.

text.description: Text to enter; at most 65536 UTF-8 bytes.

oneOf.description: Change the state of the browser window containing the selected tab.

action_timeout_secs.description: Element interaction timeout in seconds, 1-30; default 5. Navigation, page-condition waits and downloads have separate limits.

actions.description: Ordered steps for execute. Element interactions auto-wait. If a step changes later targets, end the batch and use fresh refs from its feedback. Validated before execution; a runtime failure stops without undoing completed steps. Requires AI control.

op.description: Default execute runs actions. wait/cancel uses task_id to retrieve or cancel a task; unrelated execution options are ignored, but new actions are rejected.

page_id.description: Execute only: initial tab for page actions, from browser_snapshot(view='tabs'). Default: the focused tab, or an available tab. Selecting it does not redirect desktop keyboard input.

task_id.description: Required for wait/cancel: task_id returned by a browser or screenshot tool.

then.description: Page feedback: usually omit for default diff; snapshot returns the full view, none omits feedback. Failures retain completed results and available observations.

timeout_secs.description: Task deadline in seconds, including preparation and all steps; default 120.

wait_secs.description: Task wait limit in seconds; default 30, zero polls immediately. Ignored for execute. Does not extend the task deadline.

name: browser_read
description: Read page text or extract tables, links and fields, including iframes. Use query to find a known target and obtain refs; use ref to scope a read. For page structure and panels, use browser_snapshot.

extract.description: Extract tables, links or fields within ref, or across the page and iframes. Default: plain text. Excludes query; ignores max_chars. Results indicate truncation.

max_chars.description: Plain-text character limit; default 4000. Ignored for query or extract.

page_id.description: Page ID from browser_snapshot(view='tabs'). Default: focused tab, or an available tab.

query.description: Find observed elements by a case-insensitive substring of their name or text, including iframes. Optional ref scopes the search. Returns up to 20 matches. Excludes extract; ignores max_chars.

ref.description: Element ref from an observation. Read its content or extract within its subtree. Default: main page content. Also scopes query results.

name: screen_observe
description: Capture unannotated page or desktop images, reduced proportionally to a maximum edge of 1980 pixels. Page captures cover the currently rendered full document; use browser_read for long text. For native browser UI use view=desktop. Supports timed sequences and saving original PNGs. Use returned image_id and image-pixel coordinates for actions. While state=running, retrieve the same task with browser_act(op="wait").

count.description: Number of images to capture: 1-8; default 1.

interval_secs.description: Minimum seconds between capture starts when count>1; default 1, zero captures back to back. Ignored for count=1. Actual intervals may be longer; the sequence must fit within 600 seconds.

page_id.description: For view="page": page ID from browser_snapshot(view='tabs'). Default: the focused tab, or an available tab. Selected once for the sequence; closing it ends capture with an error. Ignored for view="desktop".

save_dir.description: For save_original=true: absolute directory in the connected space; default /workspace/agent-space/artifacts. Creates missing directories without overwriting files. Otherwise ignored.

save_original.description: Also save original captured PNGs before resizing or WebP encoding, and return their paths in files; default false.

view.description: Required: "page" captures the selected page's complete currently rendered document, including iframe regions as displayed; "desktop" captures the entire Runcove desktop, including native dialogs. Independent scroll areas and iframes show their currently displayed contents. Does not load lazy content or expand virtual lists.
